title: Such an amazing experience
text: So much fun and so good to try different wines, and cheeses etc. We learned a lot
author: 460fionam

title: A must for food and wine lovers!
text: A wonderful tasting experience with excellent local wines, delicious cheeses, and high-quality Iberian cured meats. Everything was beautifully paired, and the guide's explanations made the experience even more enjoyable.
author: paucxmbil

title: Worth it
text: Really enjoyable experience where we learned about different sangrias. I would add this to your itinerary if you are planning visiting Seville!
author: sophiakD7446ZH

title: Sangria Tasting
text: Very enjoyable experience, can highly recommend. Interesting to hear about the four different types of Sangria
